compiled_state.title: Implement _outbound_create rollback via _call_with_retry(delete_issue)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Rollback after failed outbound_create invokes delete_issue through _call_with_retry with same retry budget as create_issue

Flesh out _outbound_create(mutation) in applier.py: try _call_with_retry(client.create_issue, payload, retry_budget=RETRY_BUDGET); on exception, _call_with_retry(client.delete_issue, key, retry_budget=RETRY_BUDGET) — SAME budget constant; re-raise original create exception. Use existing _call_with_retry helper; do not reimplement.

## Test Approach
Given client.create_issue patched to raise RuntimeError on every retry, client.delete_issue MagicMock; When _outbound_create(mutation) invoked; Then _call_with_retry observed called with (client.delete_issue, key, retry_budget=RETRY_BUDGET); RuntimeError re-raised.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py
- [ ] Rollback calls delete via _call_with_retry with same budget
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_rollback.py::test_rollback_invokes_delete_via_call_with_retry
- [ ] Original create exception re-raised
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_rollback.py::test_create_exception_reraised

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_rollback.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): RETRY_BUDGET constant is owned by task-1/task-3 (see task-3 revision). Task-4 assertion asserts the SAME constant value is passed to both _call_with_retry(client.create_issue, ...) and _call_with_retry(client.delete_issue, ...). Test uses _load_acli() patch pattern matching existing test_applier.py conventions (do not introduce alternate isolation pattern).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2 (cycle 2 plan review feedback): If delete_issue rollback exhausts RETRY_BUDGET, the resulting exception is RE-RAISED (not swallowed). Add AC: structured log entry emitted with both original create error and rollback error (use logging.exception or equivalent). Add fault-injection test test_outbound_create_rollback_exhaustion_reraises: Given client.create_issue raises + client.delete_issue raises (exhausts retries); When _outbound_create invoked; Then both exceptions logged AND the rollback exception re-raised (not the original create exception, since rollback failure is the failure mode that needs visibility).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Promote rollback-exhaustion test to AC verify line. AC additions: (a) pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_rollback.py::test_outbound_create_rollback_exhaustion_reraises [client.create_issue raises + client.delete_issue exhausts RETRY_BUDGET → rollback exception re-raised AND structured log entry contains both original create error and rollback error]; (b) structured log assertion: logging.exception called with the rollback exception, not swallowed.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Rollback delete_issue must tolerate 404 / NotFoundError as terminal-success — do NOT consume RETRY_BUDGET; only transient errors (network, 5xx, rate-limit) retry. Add test: _outbound_create raises post-create + delete_issue raises NotFoundError on first call → rollback returns cleanly + original create exception is the one surfaced (not rollback exhaustion). Rationale: avoids false-positive rollback-exhaustion alerts on partial-create-then-already-gone scenarios (missing_error_path).
comments.author: Test
